candidates.description: This vector represents sexually explicit content and pornography.
This feature vector represents prominent brand names, media entities, and organizations spanning technology, entertainment, and hospitality.
This vector activates strongly for words, roots, and names related to sexuality, sexual anatomy, and identity.
This vector is related to digital technology, the internet, and online media.
This feature activates on the Roman numeral four or strings containing the letters "iv."
This feature vector represents the prefix, root, or abbreviation associated with the words "virtual" and "reality" (VR).
This feature vector activates strongly on common Italian grammatical function words and verbs.
This vector is related to words and roots associated with applying pressure, force, or movement forward and backward.
This vector activates on words and word fragments related to economics, commerce, and finance.
This vector activates on words containing the character sequence "oci" or "odi" regardless of their surrounding context.
